title: 12、回归（修）
content_zh:
一旁伫立的叶晚听此话便驱散了旁观的人群，让两人安心交谈。
“算是刚才赢下残局的奖励？可以，”李叔同回答道。
“刚才的口琴声是你吹的吗？”庆尘问道。
叶晚和林小笑明显愣了一下，他们还以为庆尘要借着赢棋的机会问什么呢，结果竟然只是问这支曲子？
曲子很好听，也没有在外面流传过，但也不至于让庆尘浪费这么重要的机会吧。
李叔同笑意盈盈的抬头说道：“是我，怎么了，第一次听到这个旋律吗？”
庆尘想了想说道：“很好听。”
“嗯，”李叔同见人群散去才点点头回答：“他是我们组织创始人谱的曲，词也是他作的。”
庆尘怔然了半天都说不出话来，他很想说：我猜你们那位创始人，可能是地球人！
而且这位创始人好像也有点不要脸啊，搬运歌曲竟当成自己的作品。
等等，李叔同他们这个组织创立多久了，也不知道那位穿越的前辈是什么时候穿的？
庆尘再问：“您能完整的给我唱一遍吗？我想听。”
李叔同说道：“可以，不过这首曲子的歌词并不是太完整，漫长的时光里，总会有东西丢在那条长河中。”
“没事，我只是听听，”庆尘说道，他想确认，这首歌的歌词是否也跟地球一样。
李叔同将桌上的大猫抱进怀里，然后轻声唱道：“长亭外，古道边，芳草碧连天，晚风拂柳笛声残，夕阳山外山。天之涯，地之角，离别有时多……”
李叔同唱完后笑道：“离别有时多这句歌词是后人补上的，据说当初并不是这样，只不过不管怎么补，好像都差了点意思。”
庆尘伫立良久后突然说道：“换成知交半零落怎么样？”
“知交半零落？”李叔同愣了一下。
不知道为何，他总觉得只有这五个字才配的上这首歌。
送别送别，人如夕阳余晖，知己远在天涯。

彼此年少时开怀畅饮，生命浓烈如盛夏。
可不知哪一次送别便是最后一面，从此不再相见。
李叔同仿佛坐在这监狱里看到了橙红色的太阳正在落入地平线，而好友正在远方跟他招手。
招手之后，便转身离去了。
“谢谢，”李叔同说道：“这句补的真好，就像是这首歌原本的歌词就应该是这句一样。”
“不客气，”庆尘厚着脸皮接下了这句夸奖。
李叔同有些向往的说道：“有时候真的很惊叹，我们那位创始人真是惊才绝艳之人，据说当年他所做的词曲多如牛毛，每一首都是传世经典，只不过在上一个纪元终结的时候都流失了，只剩下这么一首曲子。”
“只剩一首了吗？那还真是可惜了，”庆尘心说，李叔同直接提及上一个纪元，恐怕那位穿越者前辈应该是很久很久以前穿越过来的吧。
纪元并不是一个时间单位，而是一个新文明的开端。
看样子，这里的人类曾经历过一个纪元的迭代，只是不知道发生了什么。
“还有一首是只知道名字，但根本不知道旋律，前辈们翻找过很多遗址，都没能找到谱子，”李叔同摇头道。
庆尘迟疑了两秒，然后试探着问道：“那首曲子叫什么名字？”
李叔同看了他一眼说道：“卡农。”
如果说之前庆尘对这位创始人的穿越者身份还持怀疑态度，那么这下就完全肯定了。
不过卡农其实是一种音乐体裁、技法，许多交响作品里都会用《卡农》的技巧部分，比如贝多芬的《命运交响曲》、巴赫的《五首卡农变奏曲》。
但如果对方真是从地球照搬的话，那旋律应该就是帕赫贝尔的《D大调卡农》了。
庆尘在想，以李叔同对那位创始人的态度，自己如果将卡农的谱子送给他，是否能换来超凡脱俗的那条路？
他不确定，他甚至没法解释自己是从哪里得到这个谱子的。
再等等吧，现在庆尘也没记过卡农的谱子，还是等回归之后再细细权衡。
交谈结束，庆尘直接穿过人群去了

只有保持饱满的精神状态，他才能够随时分析身边的情况。
可是，他才刚趴在
路广义想要过来跟庆尘搭话，可有怕被人看见，于是在
庆尘面无表情的抬头看向对方：“不用这么小心，李叔同已经知道你我的关系了。不过不用担心，他好像并不介意。还有，你先忙你的去，不要打扰我。”
18号监狱里到处都是监控，囚犯们给新人举行欢迎仪式都要躲到牢房里去，所以在
庆尘其实很想跟路广义套套话，搞清楚庆氏有什么计划。
但眼瞅着回归在即，他不想节外生枝了。
所以先把路广义打发走，待到他回归之后再考虑如何套话比较好。

然而路广义并没有离开，而是在一旁小声嘀咕道：“老板，我想了半天也不知道该叫您什么好，还是叫老板最顺口。”
“估计您也听庆言提起过我，我呢从小就命苦，肾脏都被我爹拿去跟有钱人换钱了，给我换了一副仿生的来代替，你说爹妈都不心疼我，还有谁疼我呢？后来我听庆言说，这次是您点名让我进来探路，说是看中了我的能力，我高兴坏了！您放心，我路广义这次绝对为您赴汤蹈火在所不辞，就算为您去死都行！”
“不过我死前还有个遗憾，您也知道我也没能上几年学，但我打小就羡慕那些有文化的人……”
庆尘终于忍不住了：“你到底想说什么啊？”
路广义：“您能不能教我下象棋啊？”
“为什么想学下棋？”庆尘愣了一下。
“因为帅啊！”路广义说道：“老板，连李叔同那样的人物都成为自己的手下败将，难道不帅吗？”
“下棋赢一两局就很有面子了吗？”庆尘摇摇头。
“当然了，打又打不过他，能下棋赢他一下也很有面子啊！”路广义理所当然的说道。
这倒是触动了庆尘一下，听路广义的意思，李叔同的战斗力似乎很强？
只听路广义继续说道：“我是真没想到老板您进来以后能跟李叔同结识，还能相处的如此融洽。以他在这18号监狱里的地位，兴许就知道咱们要找的东XC在哪里。而且，万一您能得到他的传承，这影子之争恐怕就稳当了。”

这句话里的信息量巨大，也总算让庆尘明白自己到这里的目标是什么了……找一件东西。
而且，自己正卷入一场角逐之中。
只不过庆尘依然不知道李叔同的传承是什么，只知道它非常重要。
庆尘想了想说道：“好，我教你下象棋，你现在离我远点行吗。”
“好勒好嘞，”路广义一溜烟就跑到娱乐区那边了。
夜晚，倒计时00:05：
庆尘坐在冰冷的床上，静静的看着手臂上的白色倒计时。
那倒计时里齿轮缓缓转动着，距离回归只剩下最后五分钟了。
他也不确定自己还会不会回来这里，两天时间对于他来说就像是一场梦，认识了几个人，也见识了一个不同的世界。
林小笑与李叔同的特殊，终于让他对这个世界产生了期待。
像是有一个新世界，为自己
庆尘想了想，然后用牙刷尾端在木头床板上，用力刻下“来过”两字的凹痕。
然后他又在自己手臂上拧出了一个青紫色的印子，想要看看如果自己带着伤返回地球会有什么变化。
倒计时。
世界再次破碎了，那熟悉的黑暗终于来临。

content_en:
Ye Wan, who was standing aside, heard this and dispersed the crowd of spectators, allowing the two of them to talk in peace.
"Is this a reward for winning the endgame just now? Yes," Li Shutong replied.
"Did you play the harmonica just now?" Qingchen asked.
Ye Wan and Lin Xiaoxiao were obviously stunned for a moment. They thought Qingchen was going to take advantage of the opportunity of winning the chess game to ask something, but in the end, he just asked about this piece of music?
The song is very nice and has never been circulated outside, but Qingchen shouldn't let Qingchen waste such an important opportunity.
Li Shutong raised his head with a smile and said, "It's me. What's wrong? Is this the first time you hear this melody?"
Qingchen thought for a while and said, "It sounds good."
"Yes," Li Shutong nodded and replied after seeing the crowd disperse: "He was the founder of our organization who composed the music and also wrote the lyrics."
Qingchen was stunned for a long time and was speechless. He wanted to say: I guess your founder may be from Earth!
Moreover, the founder seems to be a bit shameless, and he actually treats the songs as his own works.
Wait, how long has Uncle Li's organization been established? I don't know when the time-traveling senior wore it?
Qingchen asked again: "Can you sing it to me completely? I want to hear it."
Li Shutong said: "Yes, but the lyrics of this song are not very complete. Over time, there will always be things lost in the long river."
"It's okay, I'm just listening," Qingchen said. He wanted to confirm whether the lyrics of this song were the same as those on Earth.
Li Shutong took the big cat on the table into his arms, and then sang softly: "Outside the long pavilion, beside the ancient road, the green grass reaches the sky, the evening wind blows the willow flute, and the sunset is outside the mountains. The end of the sky, the corner of the earth, there are many partings sometimes..."
After Li Shutong finished singing, he said with a smile: "The lyrics of parting sometimes are added by later generations. It is said that it was not like this at the beginning, but no matter how I added it, it seems that the meaning is missing."
After standing there for a long time, Qingchen suddenly said: "How about replacing it with half a close friend?"
"Have you lost all your close friends?" Li Shutong was stunned for a moment.
For some reason, he always felt that only these five words were suitable for this song.
Farewell and farewell, people are like the afterglow of the setting sun, and close friends are far away in the world.
When we were young, we drank happily, and our lives were as strong as midsummer.
But I don’t know which farewell will be the last time we see each other again, and we will never see each other again.
Li Shutong seemed to be sitting in this prison and saw the orange-red sun sinking into the horizon, and his friend was waving to him from afar.
After waving, he turned and left.
"Thank you," Li Shutong said: "This sentence is so well complemented, as if this is what the original lyrics of this song should be."
"You're welcome," Qingchen accepted the compliment shamelessly.
Li Shutong said with some yearning: "Sometimes I am really amazed. Our founder is really an amazing and talented person. It is said that he wrote so many lyrics and music back then, each of them is a classic handed down from generation to generation. However, they were all lost at the end of the previous era, leaving only this one piece of music."
"Is there only one song left? That's such a pity," Qing Chen said in his heart. Li Shutong directly mentioned the previous era. I'm afraid the senior time traveler should have traveled through a long, long time ago.
An epoch is not a unit of time, but the beginning of a new civilization.
It seems that the humans here have experienced an iteration of an era, but they just don't know what happened.
"There is another song for which I only know the name, but not the melody at all. The seniors have searched many ruins but could not find the score," Li Shutong shook his head.
Qingchen hesitated for two seconds, then asked tentatively: "What's the name of that piece of music?"
Li Shutong glanced at him and said, "Canon."
If Qingchen was still skeptical about the founder's identity as a time traveler before, now he is completely sure of it.
However, canon is actually a musical genre and technique, and can be found in many symphonic works.Can use the technical parts of "Canon", such as Beethoven's "Symphony of Destiny" and Bach's "Five Canon Variations".
But if the other party really copied it from the earth, the melody should be Pachelbel's "Canon in D Major".
Qingchen was thinking, given Li Shutong's attitude towards the founder, if he gave him the score of Canon, would he be able to gain an otherworldly path in exchange?
He wasn't sure, he couldn't even explain where he got the score.
Just wait a moment, Qingchen hasn't memorized Canon's music score yet, so he'd better weigh it carefully after his return.
After the conversation ended, Qingchen went straight through the crowd.
Only by maintaining a full mental state can he be able to analyze the situation around him at any time.

Lu Guangyi wanted to come over and talk to Qingchen, but he was afraid of being seen, so he
Qingchen looked up at the other party expressionlessly: "Don't be so careful, Li Shutong already knows about our relationship. But don't worry, he doesn't seem to mind. Also, go about your business first and don't disturb me."
There are surveillance cameras everywhere in Prison No. 18, and the prisoners have to hide in their cells when holding welcome ceremonies for newcomers, so in
Qingchen actually wanted to talk to Lu Guangyi and find out what Qing's plan was.
But seeing his return coming soon, he didn't want to cause trouble.
So it would be better to send Lu Guangyi away first, and wait until he returns to consider how to use the words.

However, Lu Guangyi did not leave. Instead, he whispered from the side: "Boss, I have been thinking about it for a long time and I still don't know what to call you. It is most convenient to call you boss."
"I guess you've heard Qingyan mention me. I've been miserable since I was a child. My father gave away my kidneys to rich people in exchange for money, and gave me a bionic one instead. You said my parents don't care about me, so who else cares about me? Later? Come and listen to Qing Yan, this time you asked me to come in to explore the way, saying that you took a fancy to my ability, I am so happy! Don’t worry, I, Lu Guangyi, will go through fire and water for you this time, even if I die for you! "
"But I still have one regret before I die. As you know, I didn't get to go to school for a few years, but I have envied those educated people since I was a child..."
Qingchen finally couldn't help it anymore: "What exactly do you want to say?"
Lu Guangyi: "Can you teach me how to play chess?"
"Why do you want to learn to play chess?" Qingchen was stunned for a moment.
"Because he's handsome!" Lu Guangyi said: "Boss, even a figure like Li Shutong became his defeat, isn't he handsome?"
"Does it feel good to win one or two games of chess?" Qingchen shook his head.
"Of course, I can't beat him again and again, so it would be very honorable to beat him in chess!" Lu Guangyi said matter-of-factly.
This touched Qingchen a bit. From what Lu Guangyi said, Li Shutong seemed to be very powerful in combat?
Just listen to Lu Guangyi continue to say: "I really didn't expect you, boss, to get to know Li Shutong after you came in, and to get along so harmoniously. With his status in Prison No. 18, he might know where the Dong XC we are looking for is. Moreover, if you can get his inheritance, this shadow battle will probably be safe."
The amount of information in this sentence was huge, and Qingchen finally understood what his goal was here... to find something.
Moreover, he is involved in a competition.
It's just that Qingchen still doesn't know what Li Shutong's inheritance is, he only knows that it is very important.
Qingchen thought for a moment and said, "Okay, I'll teach you how to play chess. Can you stay away from me now?"
"Okay, okay," Lu Guangyi quickly ran to the entertainment area.
Night, countdown to 00:05:
Qingchen sat on the cold bed and quietly looked at the white countdown on his arm.
The gears in the countdownSlowly turning, there are only the last five minutes left before return.
He was not sure whether he would come back here again. The two days were like a dream to him. He met a few people and saw a different world.
The specialness of Lin Xiaoxiao and Li Shutong finally made him look forward to the world.
It's like there is a new world for myself
Qingchen thought for a moment, then used the end of his toothbrush to carve an indentation with the word "came here" on the wooden bed board.
Then he twisted out a purple mark on his arm, hoping to see what would happen if he returned to Earth with the injury.
